name: 緑化委員会の報酬を職責に応じた額に
summary: 緑化委員会の会長と学識経験者の報酬額を定めています。改正により、報酬額をそれぞれの職責に応じたものにします。施行日は令和8年7月31日です。

en.name: Sets Greening Committee compensation according to responsibilities
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Nerima City Ordinance on Remuneration and Expense Reimbursement for Part-Time Special-Status Employees
en.summary: This ordinance sets the compensation amounts for the chair of the Greening Committee and its members with expertise. The amendment makes their compensation amounts reflect their respective responsibilities. It takes effect on July 31, 2026.
changes: Sets the compensation amounts for the chair and members with expertise according to their responsibilities
who: Members of the Greening Committee with expertise
